programme.title: The Wandering Earth 2 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Humans built huge engines on the surface of the earth to find a new home. But the road to the universe is perilous. In order to save earth, young people once again have to step forward to start a race against time for life and death.

programme.title: My Worst Neighbor [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Seung Jin, an aspiring singer who prepares for an audition, moves into a new room after a long search. But, on his first night, he hears an unidentifiable sound - a sabotaging work of Rani, the next-door neighbor who has repeatedly evicted her neighbors after being bothered by their noise. After a bizarre noise war with a wall between them, they agree to share the time to make noises. As they share daily lives with their nameless, faceless neighbor, they develop feelings for each other.

programme.title: Better Days [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A bullied teenage girl forms an unlikely friendship with a mysterious young man who protects her from her assailants, while she copes with the pressures of her final examinations.

programme.title: The Roundup [English Dub]
programme.desc: Four years after the sweeping operation of Garibong-dong, Detective Ma Seok-do and his unit have an extradition mission - to transfer a surrendered suspect from Vietnam. When Ma and Team Leader Jeon meet him, he seems fearful of something. Ma and Jeon find out that he gets involved in a kidnap/murder case: the victim is a young businessman whose father is the giant loan shark in Seoul. The leader of the crime, Kang Hae-sang, is responsible for several other kidnap/murder cases targeting Koreans in Vietnam. Ma and his colleagues start to chase after Kang before he commits more horrible crimes.

programme.title: Yesterday Once More [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gu Yuxuan and Han Shuyan almost had a fated encounter when they were children. After they grew up, the two met again as they are destined to fall in love. After experiencing the happiness and sweetness of love, they had to face the test of fate together. Can the miracle of love keep them together?

programme.title: Caught In Time [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A detective leads a task force to hunt down a notorious gang of serial thieves & killers led by a charismatic sociopath in this crime-thriller based on real events.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop named Kit busts a major gangster only to find his cover blown and his main witness gone. The gangster, in retaliation, has him kidnapped and put in a Thai jail with a false criminal identity. Lowly prison guard Chai, with his extraordinary fighting skills, guards Kit and prevents his escape. The prison guard’s daughter suffers from a rare form of leukemia and Kit is the only donor who can save her. The prison guard discovers Kit’s real identity and helps him to escape in return for his agreeing to save his daughter. Together, Kit and Chai must face and take down the gangster and his minions.

programme.title: Railway Heroes [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: This gripping historical drama tells the true story of the Shanghai Rail Corps, a team of railroad workers turned secret resistance fighters during the Second Sino-Japanese war.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A father and son team attempt to save a town hit by a series of natural disasters in this blockbuster that's as poignant as it is action-packed.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration [English Dub]
programme.desc: After a terror incident occurs mid-flight, a passenger jet declares an emergency.

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.
